summary.text: 识 is the standardized simplified counterpart of 識, used for “recognize,” “understand,” and “know.” Traditional 識 is analyzed as a phonosemantic compound: 言 marks a speech-related category and 戠 supplies a sound cue. In 识, these components appear as 讠 and 只 through simplification.

formation.text: Traditional 識 is a phonosemantic compound: 言 contributes a speech-related category, while 戠 is identified as its phonetic. In standardized 识, 言 appears as 讠 and 戠 is represented by 只; that later substitution does not make 只 the historical phonetic of 識.

components.text: 讠 is the simplified left-side form of 言. Since 言 supplies the speech-related category in 識 and 讠 continues that element in 识, it carries the corresponding semantic role.
只 represents 戠 in standardized 识 through component simplification. This replacement does not establish 只 as the historical phonetic of 識.
In traditional 識, 言 contributes a speech-related semantic category.
In traditional 識, 戠 is analyzed as phonetic. The cited historical readings are compatible with that role, although the comparison alone does not prove the graph’s formation.

sound_limitation.text: The supplied historical comparison is compatible with 戠 serving as the phonetic in 識, but does not by itself establish that role. The proposed wooden-stake origin for 戠 also does not establish the object’s original name or pronunciation.

sound.text: In the Baxter–Sagart 2014 system, 戠 *tək is compatible with 識 *s-tək, glossed “know.”
The same system also gives 識 *tək-s, glossed “remember, commemorate”; this is a distinct reading, also compatible with the phonetic analysis.
The supplied current Mandarin readings are 戠 zhī and 識 shí or shì. This modern comparison does not establish their historical sound relationship.

history.text: The curated image is a modern redraw of a seal-script-style form of 識, not a dated artifact. The available material gives no dated early specimen or graphic sequence for the compound; forms of 戠 are evidence about that component, not the compound’s appearance.
Standardized 识 simplifies 識 by rendering 言 as 讠 and representing 戠 with 只. The proposed derivation of 识 from 䛊 is not established by the cited graphic evidence.

uncertainties.text: The traditional analysis identifies 戠 as the phonetic in 識, and the supplied same-system historical readings are compatible with that account. A proposed wooden-stake origin for 戠 does not establish the object’s name or pronunciation, so it cannot independently explain the sound relation.
The proposed derivation of simplified 识 from 䛊 is not established by the cited graphic evidence.

senses.text: Traditional 識 is used with meanings including “know” and “recognize.” The cited examples and glosses do not establish when these uses began.

Remembering or retaining is identified as an early sense and illustrated with classical examples. The evidence does not establish that it was the earliest attested sense or preceded knowing and recognizing.
Current glosses include “recognize,” “understand,” and “know.” The evidence does not establish how these uses developed from remembering or other historical senses.

limitations.text: The evidence does not establish which recorded sense came first or how remembering, recognizing, knowing, and further uses developed into one another.

overview.text: 识 is the simplified form of 識, used for “know” and “recognize.” In traditional 識, 言 marks a speech-related category and 戠 supplies a compatible sound cue. The simplified 只 represents 戠 only in 识.

只 represents 戠 in simplified 识; this later substitution does not make 只 the traditional graph’s sound source.

戠 supplies the sound cue in traditional 識; the cited historical readings are compatible with that analysis.

These comparisons are compatible with the analysis but do not alone establish graph formation. A proposed stake-like origin for 戠 does not establish the object’s name or pronunciation.
The standard lists 只〔戠〕 as a simplified component and 识〔識〕 beneath it, supporting 只 as the component representing 戠 in standardized 识.

讠 is the simplified side form of 言. Because 言 contributes the speech-related category in 識 and 识 is simplified from 識 with 言 rendered as 讠, the corresponding semantic contribution is carried into the simplified graph.
